newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine gives Italian car venture upgrade aid.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine gives Italian car venture upgrade aid.

text.p: Ukraine will grant eight million hryvnias to Ukrainian-Italian truck maker AvtoKrAZ for modernisation, the Minister for Machine-Building, the Military Complex and Conversion said on Tuesday.
"We have already designated eight million hryvnias to AvtoKrAZ, which should be enough to help the plant begin to modernise," Vasyl Hureyev told Reuters.

The government also decided last week to give AvtoKrAZ -- A $100 million venture with Italy's Iveco, which is a subsidiary of Fiat SpA -- a credit of five million hryvnias from Ukraine's Innovation Fund.
AvtoKrAZ, Ukraine's only truck builder, manufactures 1.3- tonne to 20-tonne vehicles.
It manufactured 10,000 units in 1995 and hopes to boost output to 30,000 units by 2000.
